rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for the eating spoon and for the tablespoon measure in recipes.

example.english: This recipe needs one tablespoon of soy sauce.
example.traditional: 呢個食譜要加一湯匙豉油。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 sik6 pou2 jiu3 gaa1 jat1 tong1 ci4 si6 jau4

rows.note: Use this for the larger ladle-like spoon used to cook or serve food rather than to eat with.

example.english: They used a tablespoon to ladle the soup into the bowls.
example.traditional: 佢哋用湯勺將啲湯舀入啲碗度。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jung6 tong1 soek3 zoeng1 di1 tong1 jiu5 jap6 di1 wun2 dou6

rows.note: Use this as a less common alternative for the large spoon used for eating from a bowl.

example.english: This tablespoon is so big, perfect for eating soup.
example.traditional: 呢隻湯羹咁大，啱晒飲湯。
example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 tong1 gang1 gam3 daai6 ngaam1 saai3 jam2 tong1
